Current full-width hero, responsive supporting copy, six product cards, Sessions, commerce, four enterprise stories, startups, platforms, developer sections, current book, CTA and footer are present in original source order.

remaining: Hero WebGL wave, product checkout currencies/screens, issuing/crypto, logo marquee, orchestration logos and developer wave are source-observed frozen phases; animation timing and live GDP counter do not match later official frames.

Product artwork uses preserved raw screenshot regions of official decorative artwork. Developer wave crop excludes semantic heading/stats overlays and is stretched responsively, so its exact curve geometry differs from the live canvas.

Statistics theme is source-observed dusk on desktop and night on narrow. The official site can retain theme/accordion state across viewport changes; acceptance evidence uses independently reloaded desktop initial state. Time-of-day/graph controls do not reproduce WebGL changes.
Platform demonstration freezes the source final visible state. Official entrance animation can initially show only its gradient; no timing equivalence is claimed.
News carousel controls change text but retain the first frozen artwork; startup carousel, testimonial tabs, country selector and account/backend flows do not yet have full interaction parity.

Native 1280x720 desktop menus and all six dialogs opened and closed, and narrow Root/Products navigation/Escape were exercised. Remaining menu branches, keyboard focus behavior and all external destinations are not fully accepted.
